results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.

This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. results.title: Marion County Commissioner District Demographics
results.description:
The five Marion County Commissioner Districts, with population and growth figures attached to each district.

What is in this layer
Population for 2010, 2020 and 2025; the change and percent change across both periods; each district's share of countywide growth since 2020; land area, population density, and share of county population.

Important: not all figures are Census counts
The 2010 and 2020 populations are official U.S. Census counts (PL 94-171). The 2025 population is an estimate, produced by taking the University of Florida BEBR county total for April 1, 2025 and distributing it across districts according to where new homes were actually built, using Marion County Property Appraiser parcel records and building permits. It is not a Census figure and should be labelled as an estimate wherever it is republished.

Data vintage
Parcel and permit data as of August 2026. District boundaries from the Marion County IT-GIS Commissioner Districts layer.

Method and verification
District populations are built from Census block-level data assigned to districts by maximum areal overlap, and reconcile exactly to the published county totals of 331,298 (2010) and 375,908 (2020). The growth distribution is corroborated by two independent county systems - the Property Appraiser tax roll and the EnerGov permit system - which agree within 2.7 percentage points.
results.snippet: Commissioner District boundaries with 2010, 2020 and 2025 population and growth figures for each district.
results.licenseInfo: 2010 and 2020 figures are official U.S. Census counts. The 2025 figure is a Marion County estimate, not a Census count. Please retain that distinction in any derived graphic or publication.
results.source: Geographic Information Systems - Marion County, Florida

results.title: Public Works Permits
results.description:
Marion County Public Works, Land Development Engineering & Permits department uses the Oregon ePermitting system, Accela, to process and maintain Public Works permits. This map layer joins record information from the permit to the county's parcel centroids. Some records, such as right-of-way permits that encompass several properties, are not included at this time.

The layer includes basic information including permit status, open and expiration dates. Permit records prior to 2019 are set as Expired by default and are for informational use only. See individual permit records for details.

This dataset is updated daily.

results.name: Florida_Statewide_Cadastral
results.title: Florida Statewide Parcels
results.description:
The Florida Department of Revenue’s Property Tax Oversight(PTO) program collects parcel level Geographic Information System (GIS) data files every April from all of Florida’s 67 county property appraisers’ offices. This GIS data was exported from these file submissions in August 2026. The GIS parcel polygon features have been joined with thereal property roll (Name – Address – Legal, or NAL)file. No line work was adjusted between county boundaries.The polygon data set represents the information property appraisers gathered from the legal description on deeds, lot layout of recorded plats, declaration of condominium documents, recorded and unrecorded surveys.

Individual parcel data is updated continually by each county property appraiser as needed. The GIS linework and related attributions for the statewide parcel map are updated annually by the Department every August.  Minor data maintenance is also completed every May and November. The dataset extends countywide and is attribute by Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code.

DOR reference with FIPS county codes and attribution definitions - https://fgio.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=55e830fd6c8948baae1601fbfc33a3b2

If you discover the inadvertent release of a confidential record exempt from disclosure pursuant to Chapter 119, Florida Statutes, public records laws, immediately notify the Department of Revenue at 850-717-6570 and your local Florida Property Appraisers’ Office.

results.description:
The Florida Department of Revenue’s Property Tax Oversight(PTO) program collects parcel level Geographic Information System (GIS) data files every April from all of Florida’s 67 county property appraisers’ offices. This GIS data was exported from these file submissions in August 2026. The GIS parcel polygon features have been joined with thereal property roll (Name – Address – Legal, or NAL)file. No line work was adjusted between county boundaries.The polygon data set represents the information property appraisers gathered from the legal description on deeds, lot layout of recorded plats, declaration of condominium documents, recorded and unrecorded surveys.

Individual parcel data is updated continually by each county property appraiser as needed. The GIS linework and related attributions for the statewide parcel map are updated annually by the Department every August.  Minor data maintenance is also completed every May and November. The dataset extends countywide and is attribute by Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code.

DOR reference with FIPS county codes and attribution definitions - https://fgio.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=55e830fd6c8948baae1601fbfc33a3b2
